name: sDAO LP staking reward divided by a sweepable LP balance
summary: sDAO's LP staking spreads newly accrued rewards over the contract's live LP balance, and its permissionless withdrawTeam(token) sends the contract's whole balance of any token, staked LP included, to the team address. The attacker staked 242 LP, accrued rewards by transferring sDAO to the pair, swept all staked LP away with withdrawTeam, sent back a dust amount of LP, and claimed 3.7M sDAO through getReward, which it sold into the sDAO/USDT pair.
notes: The reset is init(pair), which pointed LPInstance (slot 6) at the sDAO/USDT pair and so enabled both the staking and the transfer-to-pair reward accrual; the later setContractArguments calls rewrote the same address. The operator's init(0) four hours after the exploit (ref) disabled it.

The anchor is the staking contract's only LP outflow ever. sDAO has no DefiLlama price; the staking contract's net 3.44M sDAO is valued at the 13,661.92 USDT the attacker realised by selling it (rule 12). The stakers' 1,652 LP swept to the team address went to the protocol, not the attacker, and is not counted.
